info.title: AtlasRisk HTTP API
info.description: Contract-first foundation for the AtlasRisk decision-support API.

200.description: Risk run lifecycle, result, and provenance
Sealed decision evidence manifest and SHA-256
Chronological decision, review, and amendment timeline

from.description: Inclusive start of the observation window.

to.description: Exclusive end of the observation window; must not exceed as_of.

as_of.description: UTC system-knowledge cutoff used to select immutable revisions.

DecisionEvidenceReference.description: Finalization requires one portfolio_snapshot, one valuation_run, and one completed risk_run for the same account/snapshot. Optional raw_object, observation_revision, price_revision, and fx_quote_revision references bind additional data evidence. Every reference is a UUID.

captured_at.description: Required for position imports; RFC 3339 with explicit offset.
Required for position imports; RFC 3339 with explicit offset.

ObservationMode.name: mode
ObservationMode.description: Clock used for a per-series observation query.

Mode.name: mode
Mode.description: Clock used for the cross-source timeline; combined is an alias for latest across the selected series.

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Client-supplied correlation identifier; the server returns one when absent.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key for retry-safe mutating requests.

ImportIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ImportIdempotencyKey.description: Required stable key for retry-safe CSV commits.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid series identifier, mode, limit, cursor, or time window

Conflict.description: Resource conflicts with an existing identifier or immutable reference

SourceAsOfUnsupported.description: The source has no defensible source-vintage clock

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Only CSV media types are accepted

RequestId.description: Correlation identifier for this response and its logs.
